g.text: 24/7 Event-Driven Financial Defense & Action Engine • Built on Google Cloud & Gemini 3.7 Flash
• Raw multipart MIME & PDF attachment extraction
• Scanned medical bills & vendor quotes (PDF, PNG)
• Stripe, Slack, and accounting webhook feeds
• Scoped access: Gmail, Calendar, Tasks, Sheets
• Next.js 14 SPA with SSR API fallbacks
• Hybrid thinking mode for complex billing codes
• Zero hallucination via strict JSON schema outputs
• CMS NCCI unbundling & mutually exclusive codes
• CFPB Debt Collection Rule (12 CFR Part 1006)
• Canonical ISO currency merging (USD, INR, EUR, GBP)
• Temporary lien & IPO mandate hold filtering
• Embedded dispute claim IDs & provider numbers
• Pre-drafted phone scripts with CFR statute references
• Real-time financial audit line item export
• Formats: .xlsx, .csv, and Google Sheets live sync
• Instant Slack & Discord priority defense alerts
AES-256-GCM client-side encryption before cloud sync
Idempotent DAG dispatching with self-healing boundaries
